credentials.description: clientId (API key), provided in the Djomy merchant space
clientSecret (secret key), provided in the Djomy merchant space

example_prompt: Add Djomy mobile money payment to my checkout.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method. OM = Orange Money, MOMO = MTN Mobile Money, KULU = Kulu (Digital Pay). SOUTRA_MONEY, PAYCARD, YMO are coming soon.

payerIdentifier.description: Payer account number. For mobile wallets, use the phone number in international format (e.g. 00224623707722). For cards, use the card number.

amount.description: Amount to be paid. Must be a positive number.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. GN for Guinea).

merchantPaymentReference.description: Your own reference for this payment (e.g. an order ID). Not required but strongly recommended.

returnUrl.description: URL to redirect the payer to after payment success or failure. Must be HTTPS.

cancelUrl.description: URL to redirect the payer to if they leave the payment page before submitting. Falls back to returnUrl if omitted. Must be HTTPS.

metadata.description: Custom key-value data echoed back in webhooks and status responses. Must be flat JSON (no arrays, no nested objects). Example: { "order_id": "ORD-456", "vip": true }

response_schema.description: All responses are wrapped in { success, message, data, error, errors, timestamp, status }.

transactionId.description: Payment id generated by Djomy (« A utiliser ulterieurement pour récupérer le détail de paiement »): store it for verify_payment. confirm_otp's example passes it as transactionReference, which the docs don't state (see confirm_otp's open questions).

status.description: PENDING: « Le payeur est sollicité par notre partenaire pour valider le paiement ».

redirectUrl.description: URL for the payer to complete the payment via redirect flow.

paymentUrl.description: « URL pour effectuer le paiement de la transaction. » (components.schemas.CreatedPaymentDto.properties.paymentUrl.description).

gotchas: For Orange Money (OM) and MTN MoMo (MOMO), « Le payeur est notifié par SMS ou via l’application Orange Money / MTN MoMo, afin de confirmer le paiement directement depuis son téléphone » (create_payment's description). Whether and when confirm_otp is also needed is not documented (see confirm_otp's open questions); its example passes the transactionId as transactionReference, which the docs don't state either.

A redirect is not a proof of payment. Fulfil from the signed webhook once its amount, currency and merchantPaymentReference match your order (see webhook_payment_completed), or from verify_payment with the same check.

metadata must be flat: « Il doit être au format JSON et ne contenir ni de list, ni de structure imbriquée » (components.schemas.InitiatePaymentCommand.properties.metadata.description); the docs' example, { "order_id": "ORD-456", "vip": true, "referrer": "campaign-2026" }, has strings and a boolean.

[VERY IMPORTANT] Unless the user explicitly requests the direct flow (no redirect), always use create_payment_gateway instead. create_payment requires you to know the payment method and payer identifier upfront. create_payment_gateway delegates everything to the Djomy portal.
A missing or invalid X-API-KEY returns HTTP 401 (documented as "Clé API manquante ou invalide").
open_questions: Production base URL: Djomy's API reference lists only https://sandbox-api.djomy.africa ("Staging environment"). Ask the user or Djomy for the production URL — never guess it.

Is a retried create_payment safe? Djomy's docs (https://developers.djomy.africa/documentation/openapi-partner.json) document no idempotency key or duplicate handling; `merchantPaymentReference` is only described as "Elle n'est pas obligatoire, mais fortement recommandée", with nothing about a reused value being rejected.
